title: Chapter 97: Verbal Dispute
content:
Chapter 97: Verbal Dispute

Except for the 2,000 direct cavalry troops of the Tengu clan, most of the troops in other territories, from top to bottom, have the idea of not wanting to be enemies with the Zerg.

They are now following orders and have to stand opposite the Zerg. They can only hope that this mission can be completed peacefully without conflict with the Zerg.

The army led by Gou Zheng marched in such an atmosphere and headed towards the city occupied by the Zerg.

He had never led an army of such a scale before, and he had no idea about the morale, emotions, etc. of the army. The generals of the Tengu clan noticed it, but he didn't care and didn't remind Gou Zheng.

When the Tengu clan army entered the city occupied by the Zerg and formed a battle formation, Gou Zheng came to the front of the battle formation with high spirits under the escort of 2,000 cavalry.

At this time, the city gate was not closed, and you could see that the city was full of Zerg puppies waiting in full battle array.

On the city wall, there are 5,000 elite alliance soldiers led by Wu Qing, Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan, and 5,000 Zerg Hydralisks. With the current strength in the city, the army under the city cannot threaten the safety of the city.

If a fight really breaks out, Wu Qing is confident that he can win the war with the strength in the city.

Seeing that the allies who fought together yesterday are now standing on the opposite side, Wu Qing also sighed.

He can see from some details that the army under the city is unwilling to be enemies with the Zerg, but he doesn't know if they have the courage to disobey the orders of the Tengu clan.

If the Tengu clan really wants to fight, Wu Qing will never show mercy, and he will not give up any of the benefits he has!

But if he can avoid this battle, he doesn't want to fight. The evil god camp is still watching from the side. At this time, it is very disadvantageous for the alliance and the Zerg to be enemies with the Tengu clan.

It was not until Wu Qing saw that the leader of the army this time was the playboy from the Tengu clan who came to meet them the day before yesterday that he smiled bitterly and said to Meng: "It seems that we have to fight this battle even if we don't want to!"

"What are you afraid of? Let's fight! It's just a pity that Niu Kun and his people have to die on such a meaningless battlefield!"

Meng and his men saw Gou Zheng leading the army and understood what Wu Qing meant.

No matter what the Tengu clan had in mind, since they let a playboy lead the army, they must want to make trouble.

The Tengu clan deliberately allowed unstable factors to affect the relationship between the two sides. It was impossible for the Zerg clan to unilaterally make peace.

Fortunately, after yesterday's battle, the Zerg clan is no longer afraid of the suppression of the Tengu clan.

In order to be on the safe side, Wu Qing quickly made some adjustments to the arrangements of the Zerg territory, ready to welcome the outbreak of the war at any time, and also to guard against the situation of being attacked from both sides.

In front of the Tengu clan army, Gou Zheng, who was proud of his status, asked a guard to come out and speak.

"Who is the boss in the city! Please come out and speak!"

Like a master, like a servant, Gou Zheng's guards shouted without politeness.

They were also people who had been angry with Gou Zheng.

This kind of scene is really suitable for Meng to deal with.

"If you have something to say, say it quickly! If you have to fart, fart quickly!"

"Come here to make a noise! Disturbing people's sweet dreams!"

Meng's response was like rolling spring thunder, shocking people's souls!

Gou Zheng's guards did not dare to speak again, and retreated tactfully. The next conversation was not something he could convey.

"Lord Meng! Look at who I am?!"

Gou Zheng went back and made up for his lessons hard, and he also had a certain understanding of Meng.

For such a naive question, Meng disdained to respond.

Seeing that Meng didn't respond to him, Gou Zheng couldn't hold back his face and shouted: "I said, let's wait and see!"

"Look, now we meet again!"

Meng still didn't respond. He felt that it was too embarrassing to have such a conversation.

One side asked childish questions, and the other side ignored them. The scene was very embarrassing.

The nearly 100,000 troops behind Gou Zheng, who could hear the words in front of the battle, felt ashamed.

The children of the big families like Gou Zheng had a strong aura and were not stage-frightened at all. They could still talk freely in the occasion of the two armies facing each other.

But what he said was very inappropriate for this scene, making him seem like he was leading the army to avenge a personal grudge.

Although he thought so, he couldn't say it.

Seeing that Meng still didn't respond to him, Gou Zheng also slowly calmed down from that high-spirited and complacent mentality.

"I came here this time to fulfill a mission for the tribe!"

"You seized the spoils of our tribe, it's time to return them!"

"It was late yesterday, and for the sake of alliance, our tribe allowed you to stay overnight!"

"It's still early now, you can withdraw to the territory!"

"As for your contributions in this battle, our tribe will reward you according to your contributions!"

"You just need to go back and wait to receive the reward!"

Even if you haven't eaten pork, you have seen pigs run. Gou Zheng is from a big tribe and is smart and clever. He has seen a lot of occasions. It's no problem for him to learn from those superiors to say a few inappropriate words.

"We are just allies in the same camp, not vassal relations!"

"We won the spoils with our strength, why should we give them to you?!"

"Little kid, go back and ask your parents, if it weren't for our help, would you still have the opportunity to speak nonsense to us here now!?"

Meng's voice was like a super loud speaker. The entire Tengu clan army could hear it clearly, and the Tengu clan garrisons in the nearby military camps could also hear it clearly.

When everyone thought about it, it was indeed true. Without the sudden appearance of the Zerg, the evil god camp army was caught off guard. With the strength of the Tengu clan camp alone, this battle could not be won!

Gou Zheng was a little speechless for a moment, but he was still quite witty and asked back: "If there was no bloody battle of our army, could you defeat the evil god camp army alone?"

"We can win!"

Meng's answer was neat and confident. He really had confidence in the Zerg!

"It is precisely because your Tengu clan and various territories paid a heavy price for the victory of this battle that we only occupy this small city and give up all other interests!"

Meng explained that he knew that the cause of the war must have a legitimate reason. Even if a battle is to be fought, this principle must be won. Don't underestimate the victory or defeat of this principle, which can sometimes affect the entire battle situation.

Gou Zheng didn't know whether the Independent Territory Alliance and the Zerg had gained or lost by occupying this city. He also didn't understand what role the Independent Territory Alliance and the Zerg had played in this war.

He really didn't know what to say next.

He only knew that he had to complete the task his uncle had given him today and take back this city. The success or failure of this task could be said to determine his future fate.

Since he couldn't win with reason, he would use his good dandy approach. I wanted something, even if I had to kill people and set fire to it, I would take it!

"So, you don't agree to return it?!"
